goal: Leave the house and walk north out of Pallet Town toward Route 1; Professor Oak will stop you and bring you to his lab.
In Oak's lab, choose a starter Pokémon from the Poké Balls on the table.
Battle your rival in Oak's lab (he challenges you as you try to leave).
Go north through Route 1 to Viridian City and enter the Poké Mart to receive Oak's Parcel.
Bring Oak's Parcel back to Professor Oak in his lab in Pallet Town and talk to him.
Head north from Viridian City through Route 2 and Viridian Forest toward Pewter City.
Defeat Brock, the Pewter City Gym Leader (Rock/Ground Pokémon, Lv12-14). Water, Grass and Fighting moves are strong against him; Fire and Normal moves are weak against Rock.
Travel east from Pewter City along Route 3 and through Mt. Moon to reach Route 4 and Cerulean City.
Defeat Misty, the Cerulean City Gym Leader (Water type). Electric or Grass moves are strong against her; Fire moves are weak against Water. Her team: Staryu Lv18 and Starmie Lv21 (Water/Psychic).
Go north across Nugget Bridge (Route 24) and east on Route 25 to Bill's house; help Bill and get the S.S. Ticket.
Go south from Cerulean through Route 5, the Underground Path and Route 6 to Vermilion City; board the S.S. Anne at the dock and get HM01 (Cut) from the captain.
Defeat Lt. Surge at the Vermilion City Gym (Electric type; Ground moves are strong). A small tree blocks the gym entrance.
Go back to Cerulean, east via Route 9 to Rock Tunnel (Route 10), and through it south to Lavender Town.
Go west from Lavender Town via Route 8 and the Underground Path to Celadon City.
Defeat Erika at the Celadon City Gym (Grass type; Fire, Ice, Flying moves are strong).
Find the Team Rocket Hideout under the Celadon Game Corner (poster switch), get the Lift Key, and defeat Giovanni to get the Silph Scope.
In Lavender Town, climb Pokémon Tower with the Silph Scope, defeat the Marowak ghost and rescue Mr. Fuji at the top.
Talk to Mr. Fuji in his house in Lavender Town to receive the Poké Flute.
Travel to Fuchsia City (via Route 12-15 using the Poké Flute on Snorlax, or Cycling Road via Route 16-18).
Defeat Koga at the Fuchsia City Gym (Poison type; Psychic and Ground moves are strong).
In the Safari Zone (north of Fuchsia), reach the Secret House to get HM03 (Surf); also find the Gold Teeth and give them to the Warden for HM04 (Strength).
Give the Gold Teeth to the Safari Zone Warden in Fuchsia City to get HM04 (Strength).
Enter Silph Co. in Saffron City (give the guard a drink from the Celadon rooftop vending machine to pass), use the Card Key, and defeat Giovanni.

needs.what: Get a drink from the rooftop vending machine for the Saffron guard.
Get the Card Key in Silph Co.

goal: Defeat Sabrina at the Saffron City Gym (Psychic type; Bug moves are strong, teleport pads connect the rooms).
Surf south from Pallet Town (Route 21) to Cinnabar Island. Explore the Pokémon Mansion to find the Secret Key.
Defeat Blaine at the Cinnabar Island Gym (Fire type; Water and Ground moves are strong).
Defeat Giovanni at the Viridian City Gym (Ground type; Water, Grass and Ice moves are strong).
Go west from Viridian City along Route 22 and north on Route 23 through the badge gates to Victory Road; push boulders onto switches with Strength to reach Indigo Plateau.
Elite Four: defeat Lorelei (Ice/Water). Inside the Elite Four the battles are back to back: no Pokémon Center until the end, and healing is only possible with items between and during battles.
Elite Four: defeat Bruno (Fighting/Rock). Inside the Elite Four the battles are back to back: no Pokémon Center until the end, and healing is only possible with items between and during battles.
Elite Four: defeat Agatha (Ghost/Poison). Inside the Elite Four the battles are back to back: no Pokémon Center until the end, and healing is only possible with items between and during battles.
Elite Four: defeat Lance (Dragon/Flying). Inside the Elite Four the battles are back to back: no Pokémon Center until the end, and healing is only possible with items between and during battles.
Defeat your rival, the Champion, and enter the Hall of Fame. This battle directly follows the Elite Four, with no Pokémon Center in between.
